description: This file contains a mock implementation of a thread-safe work queue used for testing purposes within the Kubernetes device eviction controller. It defines a generic Mock queue with methods to add, get, process, and simulate delays, failures, and shutdown behavior.

classes.name: Mock
classes.description: A thread-safe, generic mock implementation of a work queue for testing, supporting operations like add, get, done, delay, and failure simulation.

classes.name: MockState
classes.description: Represents the internal state of the Mock queue, including ready items, in-flight items, delayed items, failure counts, and shutdown status.

classes.name: MockDelayedItem
classes.description: Represents an item scheduled for delayed processing with an associated duration.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the queue's state slices and maps for snapshot purposes.

methods.name: SyncOne
methods.description: Adds a single item to the queue and immediately calls a sync function for processing.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current queue state.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the ready queue if it is not already present.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of ready items in the queue.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the next item for processing, marking it as in-flight, or indicates shutdown if empty.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Marks an in-flight item as processed, handling mismatched calls.

methods.name: ShutDown
methods.description: Signals the queue is shutting down.

methods.name: ShutDownWithDrain
methods.description: Signals the queue is shutting down with drain.

methods.name: ShuttingDown
methods.description: Checks if the queue is in shutdown state.

methods.name: AddAfter
methods.description: Schedules an item to be added after a delay, or adds immediately if delay is zero.

methods.name: AddRateLimited
methods.description: Records a failure for an item, increasing its retry count.

methods.name: Forget
methods.description: Removes failure record for an item.

methods.name: NumRequeues
methods.description: Returns the number of retries for an item.
